description:
Title: LAN Party

You are planning a LAN party for 10 friends, so the first thing you have to do is to send invitations to these 10 friends.
Next, you have to find out which games they want to play.
As soon as you have received a list of games, you can appoint a date when the LAN party is going to happen.
If 8 or more people agree on this date, you are good to continue.
Else, you have to appoint another date, until 8 people are free to join you.
While you find a date, you can find out if you have all the games your guests want to play.
If some are missing, download them.
Next, you should find out how much beer your friends will require.
If you do not have enough, buy what's missing.
After that, you can enjoy the LAN party.

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"

                  id="Definitions_LANParty"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/lan-party">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_LANParty">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Organizer" name="Organizer" processRef="Process_LANParty"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Friends" name="10 friends"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Invitations" name="Invitations" sourceRef="Task_SendInvitations" targetRef="Participant_Friends"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_GamePreferences" name="List of requested games" sourceRef="Participant_Friends" targetRef="Task_ReceiveGameList"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DateProposal" name="Appointed date" sourceRef="Task_AppointDate" targetRef="Participant_Friends"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DateAgreements" name="Date agreements" sourceRef="Participant_Friends" targetRef="Task_CheckAgreements"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_LANParty" name="LAN Party" isExecutable="false">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_AppointDate" name="Appoint a date">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_9</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckAgreements" name="Find out how many friends agree on the date">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_DateDecision" name="Do 8 or more people agree on this date?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_8</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_9</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckGames" name="Check whether all requested games are available">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_GamesDecision" name="Are any requested games missing?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_12</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_DownloadGames" name="Download missing games">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_12</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_13</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_GamesMerge" name="Games ready">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_13</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_14</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelJoin" name="Date and games ready">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_14</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_15</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_FindBeerRequirement" name="Find out how much beer your friends require">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_15</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_16</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BeerDecision" name="Do you have enough beer?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_16</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_17</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_18</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_BuyBeer" name="Buy missing beer">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_18</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_19</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BeerMerge" name="Beer ready">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_17</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_19</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_20</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnjoyParty" name="Enjoy the LAN party">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_20</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_21</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_PartyEnjoyed" name="LAN party enjoyed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_21</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Planning" targetRef="Task_SendInvitations"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_SendInvitations" targetRef="Task_ReceiveGameList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveGameList" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_AppointDate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_CheckGames"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Task_AppointDate" targetRef="Task_CheckAgreements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_CheckAgreements" targetRef="Gateway_DateDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" name="8 or more people agree" sourceRef="Gateway_DateDecision" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">numberOfPeopleAgreeing >= 8</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" name="Fewer than 8 people agree; appoint another date" sourceRef="Gateway_DateDecision" targetRef="Task_AppointDate">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">numberOfPeopleAgreeing < 8</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_CheckGames" targetRef="Gateway_GamesDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" name="No games are missing" sourceRef="Gateway_GamesDecision" targetRef="Gateway_GamesMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">noRequestedGamesMissing</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" name="Some games are missing" sourceRef="Gateway_GamesDecision" targetRef="Task_DownloadGames">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">someRequestedGamesMissing</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_DownloadGames" targetRef="Gateway_GamesMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Gateway_GamesMerge" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin" targetRef="Task_FindBeerRequirement"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Task_FindBeerRequirement" targetRef="Gateway_BeerDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" name="Enough beer" sourceRef="Gateway_BeerDecision" targetRef="Gateway_BeerMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">enoughBeerAvailable</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" name="Not enough beer" sourceRef="Gateway_BeerDecision" targetRef="Task_BuyBeer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">notEnoughBeerAvailable</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Task_BuyBeer" targetRef="Gateway_BeerMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="Gateway_BeerMerge" targetRef="Task_EnjoyParty"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" sourceRef="Task_EnjoyParty" targetRef="EndEvent_PartyEnjoyed"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
